gold_note: Sauropod reduced consensus, read by eye from a low-resolution raster (884x976 px, small type) at 2-6x. Labels kept as internal labels: Euhelopodidae and Diplodocoidea (on their stems), CMT clade (the caption's 'Core Mamenchisaurus-like Taxa'), Turiasauria, Neosauropoda, Macronaria, Titanosauriformes, Titanosauria and Lithostrotia (each printed just left of its node's vertical line). Support values and circled Bremer values are not encoded. Polytomies: Cetiosaurus-Haute Moulouya taxon-Omeisaurus maojanus-the rest; Omeisaurus tianfuensis-Cetiosauriscus-Euhelopodidae-the rest; the four-tip Qijianglong node; Losillasaurus-Turiasaurus-Zby; Camarasaurus-Tehuelchesaurus-Janenschia pair; Brachiosaurus-Cedarosaurus pair-Sonorasaurus clade; Wintonotitan-the Paluxysaurus clade-the rest; Tastavinsaurus-Angolatitan pair-the five-tip node; the five-tip node (Baotianmansaurus to Padillasaurus); Notocolossus-Patagotitan-Puertasaurus; Rapetosaurus-Aeolosaurus-Alamosaurus pair-the Isisaurus clade. 92 tips, 11 polytomies (4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 5, 3, 4 children); 9 printed clade names kept as internal node labels.
